marketing_description: The Makita GSL02M1 Double Bevel Sliding Miter Saw features a 8-1/2 in blade diameter and 5/8 in arbor size, powered by a 40 V brushless motor that delivers 4800 RPM for faster cutting. The double bevel sliding design and Automatic Torque Drive Technology enable versatile cutting applications and adjust cutting speed under load. The electric brake and soft start ensure increased operator safety and smooth start-ups.
